caption: Easy, nourishing meal for busy days 🤍 Feta Egg Pasta Ingredients: • 1 cup cooked pasta • 1 tbsp butter • ¼ cup milk • 3 tbsp feta cheese • 1 egg Instructions: Mix egg, feta, and milk. Add pasta and butter to a baking dish. Pour mixture on top and mix. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes. — This is one of those meals I make when I don’t feel like cooking but still want something warm and balanced.
